title: did-00: drop out-of-band signature mechanism
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-did-00 says the signature mechanism and parameters are deployment-defined and peers MUST agree on it out of band; federation-00 now mandates RFC 9421 Ed25519 signed requests. Align did-00 (and its DID-identity verification hook used by sh60's host-less binding rule). Follow-up to jmap-chat-spec-sh60 (peer auth via RFC 9421 signatures, approved 2026-10-19).
